title: How Reasoning Evolves from Post-Training Data: An Empirical Study Using Chess
paper_type_zh: 国际象棋推理数据发布与后训练实证研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计 rollout、搜索轨迹、程序化验证、SFT/RL 数据谱系及其复现边界的读者
one_line: Releases a 120M-token chess SFT dataset and code spanning filtered Llama 4 Maverick responses, programmatic alpha-beta-style search traces, and engine-derived best-move and best-line targets, then studies their downstream RL behavior.
该工作发布一个约 1.20 亿 token 的国际象棋 SFT 数据集和代码；数据涵盖经筛选的 Llama 4 Maverick 回答、程序化的类 alpha-beta 搜索轨迹，以及引擎生成的最佳走法和最佳线路目标，并研究其下游 RL 行为。
why: It exposes concrete Track 5 data objects—accepted teacher responses and verbalized, engine-valued search paths—while documenting the selection contract and the boundary that rejected pools, sampling parameters, and raw-position provenance are still incomplete.
inclusion_reason: A public, author-linked chess reasoning-data release that makes both filtered multi-attempt teacher traces and programmatically generated alpha-beta/optimal-line traces inspectable, while connecting them to SFT and chess-engine-verifiable RL.

title: Problem
问题
html: The work studies how post-training data types shape chess reasoning in a domain where moves, positions, and targets can be checked by a chess engine. It addresses the need to compare teacher-written responses with programmatically constructed search and target traces while keeping the feedback contract visible.
该工作研究不同类型的后训练数据如何塑造国际象棋推理；在这一领域中，走法、局面和目标可以由国际象棋引擎检查。它回应了如下需求：在保持反馈契约可审计的前提下，比较教师模型书写的回答与程序化构造的搜索轨迹和目标轨迹。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: It releases a chess SFT mixture and accompanying code that joins filtered Llama 4 Maverick responses, guided-synthetic natural-language explanations, and engine/harness-generated records such as verbalized alpha-beta pruning (VABP), Factual Board Answering, Best Move, and Best Line. The central feedback object is programmatic chess-engine checking or engine-derived targets, while a separate gpt-oss-120b faithfulness analysis is not treated as that core verifier.

它发布一个国际象棋 SFT 混合数据集及配套代码，将经筛选的 Llama 4 Maverick 回答、引导式合成的自然语言解释，以及由引擎或程序框架生成的记录结合起来；后者包括 verbalized alpha-beta pruning（VABP）、Factual Board Answering、Best Move 和 Best Line。核心反馈对象是程序化的国际象棋引擎检查或引擎导出的目标；另一项使用 gpt-oss-120b 的忠实度分析不应被视为这一核心验证器。

title: Method
方法
html:
Released Parquet rows share general_instruction, question, response, fen_board, fullmove_count, data_type, and data_subtype. Rejection sampling uses Llama 4 Maverick: Best Move and Worst Move keep correct answers, Predict Move keeps moves ranked in Stockfish's top 30%, and Legal Moves keeps outputs above an undisclosed IoU threshold. Guided Synthetic uses Llama 4 Maverick and gpt-oss-120b to verbalize engine-grounded chess situations.

For VABP, a custom Stockfish-based program softmax-samples candidate moves, recursively builds an engine-valued tree, stops according to depth/node/write-off criteria, verbalizes the tree, and selects a final move by minimax. Best Move supplies an engine-suggested UCI move; Best Line supplies four optimal plies and a final signed-centipawn value. SFT uses LlamaFactory; RL uses veRL with Dr. GRPO, Clip-Higher, and no KL divergence. Global teacher rollout counts, temperatures, fixed VABP settings, the Legal-Moves threshold, and the complete RL reward composition remain unknown.

发布的 Parquet 记录共享 general_instruction、question、response、fen_board、fullmove_count、data_type 和 data_subtype 字段。拒绝采样使用 Llama 4 Maverick：Best Move 和 Worst Move 保留正确答案，Predict Move 保留 Stockfish 排名位于前 30% 的走法，Legal Moves 保留 IoU 高于未披露阈值的输出。Guided Synthetic 使用 Llama 4 Maverick 和 gpt-oss-120b，对由引擎确定的国际象棋情境给出自然语言说明。

对于 VABP，一个基于 Stockfish 的定制程序以 softmax 对候选走法采样，递归构建由引擎赋值的树，按深度、节点数和 write-off 条件停止，将该树语言化，并以 minimax 选择最终走法。Best Move 提供引擎建议的 UCI 走法；Best Line 提供 4 个最优半回合及最终的带符号 centipawn 值。SFT 使用 LlamaFactory；RL 使用 veRL，并采用 Dr. GRPO、Clip-Higher 和无 KL divergence 的设置。全局教师生成 rollout 数、温度、固定的 VABP 设置、Legal Moves 阈值以及完整的 RL 奖励组成仍为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The author-linked repository, Hugging Face dataset, and collection are public. The repository describes the training release as 120M tokens; the dataset page enumerates 10,483 rejection-sampling, 10,000 VABP, 60,071 Guided Synthetic, 500,000 Factual Board Answering, 14,848,802 Best Move, and 1,604,684 Best Line records. It also supplies code, evaluation samples, final checkpoints, logs, and a visualizer; its cleaned evaluation data contains 400 samples per task.

The paper reports RL inclusion experiments with 8k samples and scaled runs with 16k samples. These released artifacts establish the data families, selected feedback rules, and implementation availability; they do not establish that every retained natural-language trace is faithful or semantically correct.

作者关联的代码仓库、Hugging Face 数据集和集合均为公开资源。代码仓库将训练发布描述为 1.20 亿 token；数据集页面列出 10,483 条拒绝采样、10,000 条 VABP、60,071 条 Guided Synthetic、500,000 条 Factual Board Answering、14,848,802 条 Best Move 和 1,604,684 条 Best Line 记录。该仓库还提供代码、评测样本、最终检查点、日志和可视化器；其清洗后的评测数据每项任务包含 400 个样本。

论文报告了使用 8k 样本的 RL 纳入实验和使用 16k 样本的扩展实验。这些公开工件证实了数据家族、已选择的反馈规则和实现可用性；但它们并不能证实每一条保留的自然语言轨迹都忠实或在语义上正确。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The contribution is an inspectable mixture that places filtered teacher rollouts beside programmatic, engine-valued search traces and short engine targets, then connects these data objects to SFT and chess-engine-verifiable RL. Its value for this track is the explicit distinction between selection rules, generated targets, and an LLM-based faithfulness analysis.
其贡献在于提供一个可检查的混合数据集：将经筛选的教师 rollout 与程序化的、由引擎赋值的搜索轨迹以及短的引擎目标并置，并将这些数据对象连接到 SFT 和可由国际象棋引擎验证的 RL。对本 track 而言，其价值在于明确区分选择规则、生成目标和基于 LLM 的忠实度分析。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The checked sources do not fully disclose raw chess-position provenance, train/evaluation split construction, overlap controls, or decontamination. They also leave unknown the global teacher-generation rollout counts and decoding temperatures, fixed VABP depth/node settings, exact task thresholds except Predict Move's top-30% rule, the complete RL reward composition, and the full rejected/pre-filter teacher pool.

The paper reports hallucinations in rejection-sampled and Guided Synthetic teacher responses, including SAN/UCI format drift. Rejection sampling can shift retained positions toward cases the teacher handles well; the authors rebalance by move count and piece type, but complete raw distributions are unavailable. Multiple different responses may share a FEN board. Dataset, code, and named external sources have different licenses, so downstream reuse needs source-level review.

已核查的来源没有完整披露原始国际象棋局面来源、训练/评测切分构造、重叠控制或去污染方法。它们也没有披露全局教师生成 rollout 数和解码温度、固定的 VABP 深度/节点设置、除 Predict Move 的前 30% 规则外的精确任务阈值、完整的 RL 奖励组成，以及完整的被拒绝/过滤前教师候选池。

论文报告，拒绝采样和 Guided Synthetic 的教师回答会出现幻觉，其中包括 SAN/UCI 格式漂移。拒绝采样可能使保留的局面分布偏向教师更擅长的案例；作者按走数和棋子类型进行再平衡，但完整的原始分布不可得。多个不同回答可以共享一个 FEN 局面。数据集、代码和所列外部来源采用不同许可证，因此下游复用需要逐一审查来源。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this release to study or audit how filtered teacher rollouts, verbalized engine search, and engine-generated targets behave as post-training data under a programmatic chess contract. It is useful for reproducing the stated SFT/RL recipe and for comparing answer-level targets with fuller search-style traces. Before reuse, verify position provenance, overlap risk, missing reward details, and the licenses of the dataset, code, and upstream sources.
可使用该发布来研究或审计：在程序化国际象棋契约下，经筛选的教师 rollout、语言化的引擎搜索和引擎生成的目标如何作为后训练数据发挥作用。它有助于复现已陈述的 SFT/RL 配方，并比较答案级目标与更完整的搜索式轨迹。复用前应核查局面来源、重叠风险、缺失的奖励细节，以及数据集、代码和上游来源的许可证。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Inspect which data family supplies each trace and whether it is teacher-written or programmatic.
  • Separate chess-engine filtering and targets from gpt-oss-120b faithfulness judging.
  • Check the disclosed Predict Move top-30% rule against undisclosed thresholds and generation settings.
  • Treat position lineage, overlap controls, and the rejected teacher pool as unresolved audit gaps.

• 检查每个数据家族提供何种轨迹，以及它是教师书写还是程序化生成。
  • 将国际象棋引擎的过滤和目标与 gpt-oss-120b 的忠实度判定区分开来。
  • 将已披露的 Predict Move 前 30% 规则与未披露的阈值和生成设置对照检查。
  • 将局面谱系、重叠控制和被拒绝的教师候选池视为未解决的审计缺口。
